out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: He reported a bitter taste in his mouth and that it felt 'as if something was separating from inside me.'

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Angel identified himself as 'the Angel Gabriel'; later a voice identified as 'Jesus' ('the true and faithful witness').
arrival.other_being_detail: Also described a strong-looking pale-skinned blond man blocking the doorway of a small airplane; he could not be touched (hand went through).

environment.environment_other_detail: Crystal-like brilliant floor; clear sky with no sun or clouds; later a city with tall buildings and a 'NASA-like' control room; space view of Earth with dark rings and points of light; 'Promised Land' between two great rivers with abundant fruit and fish; Earth consumed by fire then renewed with green grass like a golf course.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: He said he 'descended on a sort of elevator of light' and then awoke in ICU in Bogotá.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Angel Gabriel: 'Miguel, you have to go back, there is a mission for you to accomplish.' Much of the message centered on spreading God's word, prayer, and love; he later described bearing witness to others.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Explosion/detonation while mixing sensitive explosives; knife driven into abdomen with severe internal injuries; later coma and ICU course.

person_demographics.religious_background_detail: He attended an 'Assembly of God Christian Center' the night of the accident.
person_demographics.occupation: Technical Non-Com, second-in-command in the Colombian Air Force; armaments specialist/instructor (explosives and munitions).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Extensive prophetic/apocalyptic visions (end-times persecution, comet sign, world consumed by fire, resurrection/selection, 'Promised Land').
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: He described repeated cycling: black tunnel → bright light/scene (hospital OBE) → back to tunnel → light/another scene (pilots' room) → tunnel → brighter light/heavenly realm with Angel Gabriel → visions → return command → 'elevator of light' → awakening in ICU.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Tunnel/light phases repeated multiple times with different scenes.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Detailed end-times/apocalyptic narrative including advanced technology (UFO-like craft, magnetic propulsion, laser weapons), global persecution of Christians, a comet as a sign/vehicle of the 'Peacemaker', Earth consumed by fire then renewed; claim of later real-world match to a vision of his children in a specific half-built house near Bogotá; later reported a 'great white light' above his hospital bed during recovery and an unseen 'sister in Christ' visiting to pray.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: Key phrases: 'At this moment, I was in a black tunnel.' 'Soon a bright light was shining...' 'I could see myself on the gurney...' 'He replied that he was the Angel Gabriel, that I was in heaven...' 'Miguel, you have to go back, there is a mission for you to accomplish.' 'I am the true and faithful witness... Yes, you must go back.' 'I descended on a sort of elevator of light.'
